hero.subheadline: Enterprise-Grade Custom Applications for Kerala Businesses. Scalable · Secure · Professional — Custom Web Application Development Solutions | 120+ Projects | Since 2018.
hero.body: Web Application Development Company Kochi is a professional application development agency delivering custom, scalable, web application development solutions for businesses across Kerala, India, and the GCC region. Since 2018, we have completed 100+ web application development projects — from startup MVPs to large-scale enterprise systems — helping Kerala businesses build powerful digital platforms that drive growth and operational efficiency.

introBand: Every business today needs a powerful, scalable web application development solution that automates processes and enhances user experience. As a dedicated Professional Web Application Development Kochi provider, Teknoppy combines modern architecture with proven execution — using cutting-edge web application development technologies and frameworks — delivered by an in-house Kochi team specializing in web application development for startups through enterprise-scale systems.

process.intro: Our professional web application development process follows six clearly defined stages, ensuring every project is delivered on time, within budget, and built precisely to brief.

steps.title: Discovery & Requirements Analysis
steps.desc: Detailed meetings covering business goals, user personas, technical requirements. Clear expectations before coding begins.

steps.title: Architecture & Technology Selection
steps.desc: Design system architecture, select appropriate web application development frameworks, plan database structure, define API specifications.

steps.title: Development & API Implementation
steps.desc: Full-stack web application development using modern frameworks. Frontend UI, backend APIs, database integration, third-party services.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.desc: Unit testing, integration testing, security testing, performance testing, user acceptance testing.

steps.title: Deployment & Infrastructure Setup
steps.desc: Deploy to cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure), set up monitoring, configure backups, optimize web application development performance.

steps.title: Maintenance & Continuous Support
steps.desc: Monthly updates, security patches, feature enhancements, support and bug fixes.

caseStudies.intro: See how we help businesses across Kerala, India, and the GCC scale from MVP to enterprise-grade web application platforms.

blocks.label: E-Commerce Marketplace
blocks.title: E-Commerce Platform: 400% Transaction Growth in 18 Months
blocks.intro: Online marketplace in Kochi with 50,000+ products and 100,000+ active users needing scalability. Legacy system caused 25% cart abandonment, system crashes during peak seasons, missing features, no mobile experience, limited analytics, and high infrastructure costs.
approach: Rebuilt using React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS
Phased rollout across infrastructure, features, mobile PWA, and compliance
results: Transactions 100K → 500K/month (400% growth), revenue Rs. 10Cr → Rs. 45Cr (350% growth)
blocks.quote: Teknoppy's web application development transformed our platform. We went from technical nightmares to handling 5x traffic seamlessly. The 350% revenue growth speaks for itself.
blocks.author: Founder, E-Commerce Marketplace, Kochi

blocks.label: B2B SaaS Analytics
blocks.title: SaaS Analytics Platform: Enterprise Scale in 12 Months
blocks.intro: B2B SaaS providing an analytics dashboard for e-commerce businesses. Started with an MVP, scaling to enterprise customers with complex requirements — multi-tenant data isolation, real-time analytics for 1M+ events daily per customer, enterprise security and compliance, flexible billing, integration APIs, and sub-second dashboard load times.
approach: Multi-tenant architecture with real-time data processing (Apache Kafka)
TimescaleDB for analytics, Elasticsearch for search
Node.js + GraphQL for APIs on AWS infrastructure
results: Customers 100 → 500 (400% growth), MRR Rs. 10L → Rs. 50L (400% growth)
Handles 1M+ data points per customer, <1 second latency, 99.99% uptime
95% NPS score, enterprise contracts Rs. 1L–10L annually, <2% churn
blocks.quote: Teknoppy's expertise in SaaS architecture and scalability enabled us to serve enterprise customers. Their professional approach to development is exactly what we needed.
blocks.author: CEO, SaaS Analytics Company, Bangalore

blocks.label: Healthcare Network
blocks.title: Healthcare Management System: HIPAA Compliance in Production
blocks.intro: Healthcare provider network managing patient data across 200+ clinics in Kerala. Needed a secure, compliant system modernization with HIPAA compliance, secure patient-doctor communication, appointment scheduling at scale, electronic health records (EHR), telemedicine, integration with existing systems, complete audit trails, and 24/7 availability.
approach: End-to-end encryption, role-based access control (RBAC), comprehensive audit logging
SOC 2 Type II certification, HIPAA Business Associate Agreement
Patient management, EHR, scheduling, secure messaging, telemedicine video, prescription, billing/insurance, and mobile apps
results: 200+ facilities, 50,000+ patients monthly, 10,000+ appointments weekly, 99.99% uptime
HIPAA verified, zero data breaches, SOC 2 certified, zero violations in 2+ years
98% patient satisfaction, 95% doctor adoption, 60% telemedicine adoption
40% admin burden reduction, Rs. 50L annual savings, Rs. 1Cr+ annual telemedicine revenue
blocks.quote: Teknoppy's expertise in secure healthcare development and compliance was invaluable. Our patients trust the system, doctors rely on it daily. Successfully serving 200+ facilities with zero incidents.
blocks.author: Medical Director, Healthcare Network, Kerala

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about custom web application development pricing, process, and technology.

items.q: What does web application development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Web application development cost ranges from Rs. 3L for MVPs to Rs. 40L+ for enterprise systems. Cost depends on features, complexity, timeline, and team size. Custom quotes provided after understanding requirements.

items.q: How long does web application development take?
items.a: MVP: 2-3 months. Standard: 3-4 months. Enterprise: 4-6 months. We provide a detailed timeline before starting.
React, Vue.js, Angular (frontend), Node.js, Python, Java (backend), PostgreSQL, MongoDB (databases), AWS/Azure (cloud). Framework selection based on your requirements.

items.q: Do you provide web application development support after launch?
items.a: Yes. We offer maintenance packages covering updates, security patches, feature enhancements, and bug fixes. Ongoing support included.

items.q: How secure is your web application development?
items.a: Secure web application development is standard. We implement encryption, authentication, OWASP standards, regular security testing, and compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
